ITA-2.6.21 khalekapotanyāyaḥ खलेकपोतन्यायः
Theory of selective uptake
A theory to explain the process of nourishment of fundamental structural components: it states that each structural component selectively absorbs its specific nutrients just as a pigeon picks grains from a granary according to its need.

.57 khallī खल्ली
Twisting pain in upper and lower limbs
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: cramp in feet; cramp in calf; cramp in thigh; cramp in wrist; cramp in hand.
